subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------ATTN.
description: Diagram in R(AS)CM(II)-22, the section on how television, articles, and university courses positively educate listeners about classical music — and the *absence* of equivalent positive-media-involvement for alternative creativity. The prose immediately above names what the crossing diagrams: 'Only with this type of positive media involvement can anyone expect to really increase awareness of alternative creativity.' The crossing diagrams what information-dynamics actually crosses with when attraction is the working partner: INFO-DY (information dynamics — the form's own information output) is crossed with ATTN (attraction). INFO-DY sits at the upper-right with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-left to ATTN. Three lines leave the main line: one runs left to ACT (activism), with ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) rising from it; one runs right to VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), with COS-P (cosmic particulars) branching from it and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) branching in turn from COS-P; and one drops straight down to C-INFO (composite information), with AFI (affinity insight) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) branching from it.
